boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named destinations along the Hermann Park Drive corridor southeast of Rice, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Japanese Garden: Waterfalls and Stone Paths
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Enter near Molly Ann Smith Plaza, then follow the winding paths past waterfalls, bridges, a teahouse, and seasonal plantings.
cards.short_summary: A designed garden route with water, bridges, and a teahouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park describes the Japanese Garden as having waterfalls, bridges, stone paths, a teahouse, and winding paths; it is open daily with no admission charged.
cards.source_title: Points of Interest — Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Open daily; the cited page lists seasonal hours of 9 a.m.–6 p.m. Mar. 1–Oct. 31 and 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Nov. 1–Feb. 28.

cards.title: McGovern Centennial Gardens: Themed Garden Rooms
cards.subtitle: Hermann Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the pavilion entry to explore the Rose, Arid, Woodland, Celebration, and Family Gardens around Centennial Green.
cards.short_summary: An eight-acre collection of distinct garden spaces and public art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Conservancy says the gardens occupy eight acres and include themed garden rooms, including the Rose, Arid, Woodland, Celebration, and Family Gardens.
cards.source_title: McGovern Centennial Gardens — Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: 1500 Hermann Drive; seasonal hours apply and the gardens are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

cards.title: Hawkins Sculpture Walk: Ten Donated Busts
cards.subtitle: Hermann Drive corridor
cards.notes: Walk the garden entryway at Caroline and Hermann Drive to view the ten-bust sculpture line before continuing into the gardens.
cards.short_summary: A short public-art stop at the gardens’ entry.
cards.evidence_claim: The Conservancy states that Hawkins Sculpture Walk has ten busts of notable figures and lines the McGovern Centennial Gardens entryway at Caroline and Hermann Drive.
cards.source_title: Points of Interest — Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Located at the corner of Caroline and Hermann Drive, at the McGovern Centennial Gardens entryway.

cards.entity_name: Mary Gibbs and Jesse H. Jones Reflection Pool
cards.title: Reflection Pool: A Long Waterside Walk
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Follow the live-oak-lined edges of the Reflection Pool and connect onward to the Japanese Garden entrance near Molly Ann Smith Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A 740-foot pool framed by mature live oaks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Conservancy says the Mary Gibbs and Jesse H. Jones Reflection Pool measures 740 feet by 80 feet and is lined on both sides with mature live oak trees.
cards.source_title: Points of Interest — Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Within Hermann Park, which the Conservancy states is open daily from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.

cards.title: McGovern Lake: Watch the Bird Islands
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the eight-acre lake to look toward its islands, two of which are set aside for migratory birds; rentals are optional.
cards.short_summary: An eight-acre park lake with islands reserved for migratory birds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Conservancy describes McGovern Lake as an eight-acre lake with three islands, two set aside for migratory birds; pedal boats are available for rental.
cards.source_title: Points of Interest — Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Located within Hermann Park; pedestrian viewing does not require booking according to the cited park information.

cards.title: Hermann Park Railroad: See Art From the Rails
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Check the railroad stop for a ride through the park; the Conservancy identifies an artwork in the railroad tunnel visible from the train.
cards.short_summary: A park train route that passes a tunnel artwork.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park Conservancy identifies the Hermann Park Railroad as a park attraction and says Trenton Doyle Hancock’s Destination Mound Town can be seen while riding through the railroad tunnel.
cards.source_title: Art in the Park — Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Train rides require tickets; consult the Conservancy’s current visit information before going.

cards.title: Miller Outdoor Theatre: Free Performances
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Check the current performance calendar, then bring a blanket or lawn chair for hill seating or follow the seating guidance for covered shows.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor venue where every listed performance is free to attend.
cards.evidence_claim: Miller Outdoor Theatre states that all performances are free, whether attending on the hill or in the seats.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — Miller Outdoor Theatre
cards.access_notes: 6000 Hermann Park Drive; performance dates and seating procedures vary, so check the current calendar before travel.

cards.title: Houston Museum of Natural Science: Permanent Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the museum’s visit information to plan a permanent-exhibits visit, then allow time for the adjacent Hermann Park destinations.
cards.short_summary: A science museum directly on Hermann Park Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: HMNS identifies its Hermann Park museum location as 5555 Hermann Park Drive and states that a Permanent Exhibit ticket covers more than a dozen exhibits.
cards.source_title: Houston Museum of Natural Science FAQ
cards.access_notes: 5555 Hermann Park Drive; the cited FAQ lists general admission for permanent exhibits, with special-exhibit pricing varying.

cards.title: Houston Zoo: Animal and Ecosystem Learning
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Reserve or purchase admission through the zoo’s official visit channels, and build in time to explore its animal and ecosystem interpretation.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit zoo within Hermann Park focused on animals and ecosystems.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park Conservancy identifies the Houston Zoo as a private nonprofit organization where guests learn about animals and the ecosystems they live in.
cards.source_title: Points of Interest — Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: The Conservancy directs visitors to the Houston Zoo for hours and information; verify current zoo admission and timed-entry requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Lott Family Carousel: A Park Ride Stop
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Pair a carousel ride with a walk through the surrounding park, and check the Conservancy’s current operating information before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A named carousel attraction in Hermann Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park Conservancy lists the Lott Family Carousel among the park’s play and amusement attractions.
cards.access_notes: The Conservancy notes that the Lott Family Carousel is closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day; check current hours before going.
